description: This file defines a React component named UsagePage that displays usage and cost metrics related to AI model activity, API keys, provider spend, and various usage views such as organization, team, customer, and tag-based usage. It integrates with various hooks, external APIs, and UI components to facilitate data fetching, visualization, and exporting functionalities.

methods.name: getTopModels
methods.description: Calculates the top 5 models based on spend in the user activity data.

methods.name: getTopModelGroups
methods.description: Calculates the top 5 model groups based on spend.

methods.name: getTopKeys
methods.description: Calculates the top 5 API keys based on spend.

methods.name: fetchUserSpendData
methods.description: Fetches user spend data from the API, using either aggregated or paginated endpoints, based on the date range.

methods.name: handleDateChange
methods.description: Handles date range change with instant UI update and debounce.
